staticText: Private deterministic citation worksheet for common books, journal articles, webpages, and reports in APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago author-date, and a clearly labelled generic Harvard template. It does not support Chicago notes and bibliography, verify authorship or metadata, apply every title-case exception, resolve DOI values, or decide institution-specific Harvard rules. Source details stay in the browser unless the user explicitly saves them locally. Users must compare every draft with the original source and their required official style manual.
